text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month and nine-month treasury bills were unchanged, yields on six-month bills slipped and 12-month yields firmed from the last sales in Ukraine, a central bank statement said on Monday.

Three-month bills remained at 24.43 percent, six-month bills eased to 31.27 percent from 31.30 percent, nine-month bills remained at 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.89 percent from 39.87 percent.
The results of Monday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.00 million UAH 3.50 million UAH
Amount sold 2.70 million UAH 3.50 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.54 million UAH 3.299 million UAH
The central bank sold 27,010 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 22.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 5.01 million UAH 8.54 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.33 million UAH 7.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 50,110 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 22.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Actual amount raised 1.09 million UAH 237,650 UAH
The central bank sold 13,685 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 22.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 9.91 million UAH 7.545 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.09 million UAH 5.398 million UAH
The central bank sold 99,104 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 22.
